citation: Jiang, Pentelute, Collier & Zhou, "Atomic structure of anthrax protective antigen pore elucidates toxin translocation", Nature 521, 545 (2015), doi:10.1038/nature14247 (author manuscript PMC4519040; PDB 3J9C)
license: PMC author manuscript (not CC); facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
topic: Anthrax protective antigen (PA) heptamers convert at endosomal low pH from a soluble prepore into a membrane-spanning pore. Cryo-EM maps of the pore are compared with crystal structures of prepores.

facts.text: A subset of 21,632 particles gives a 3.6 A map that is in the pore state, with the domains 2c converged and the phi clamp correctly assembled, but without the 14-stranded beta barrel.
facts.locator: Main text (third layer); Extended Data Fig. 8

facts.text: The 2beta10-2beta11 loop is in the pore conformation in one octameric prepore crystal structure and in the prepore conformation in another, while the rest of the two structures is largely unchanged.
facts.locator: Main text (pH sensing); Extended Data Fig. 6

facts.text: Mutating the conserved Asn422 or Asp425 in that loop abolishes the low-pH conversion from prepore to pore.
The loop contains no histidine, the residue whose pKa of about 6 falls in the pH range where the conversion happens.
Mutations near the domain 2 / domain 4 interface, or deletion of the 2beta2-2beta3 loop, shift the pH threshold of the conversion but do not abolish its pH sensitivity.

ask: Which account of the low-pH conversion is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: The 2beta10-2beta11 loop acts as the pH sensor and flips first; the domains then converge and assemble the phi clamp, and the beta barrel forms afterwards as a consequence, not as the cause.
hypotheses.locator: Main text (pH sensing and the three layers of conformational change); Extended Data Fig. 8
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: The beta barrel forms first and pulls the domains together, which then closes the phi clamp.
hypotheses.locator: Main text (third layer); Extended Data Fig. 8
hypotheses.reason: 有一类颗粒已经收拢并装好 phi 夹，却还没有 beta 桶，说明桶不是先形成的。

hypotheses.text: Protonation of histidine residues in the sensing loop triggers the conversion.
hypotheses.locator: Main text (pH sensing): the loop possesses no His
hypotheses.reason: 该环不含组氨酸，原文据此排除组氨酸质子化这一常见机制。

hypotheses.text: The domain 2 / domain 4 interface is the pH sensor: breaking it is what makes the structure respond to acid.
hypotheses.locator: Main text (pH sensing): such mutations change the threshold but keep pH sensitivity
hypotheses.reason: 界面处的突变只移动 pH 阈值，并不取消 pH 敏感性；取消敏感性的是该环上的 Asn422/Asp425。

scale.definition: 感受 pH 的环与其邻近相互作用（约 1 nm）
